`spec.consistentHash` support has been added to `TrafficPolicy` and committed on the `feat/consistent-hash` branch.

### Summary of Changes
1. **API & CRD Types**:
   - Defined [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L5-L31), [`ConsistentHashHeader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L34-L49), [`ConsistentHashRegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L52-L61), [`ConsistentHashCookie`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L64-L89), [`ConsistentHashCookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L92-L101), [`ConsistentHashQueryParameter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L104-L114), [`ConsistentHashFilterState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L117-L127), and [`ConsistentHashSourceIP`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go#L130-L135) in [consistent_hash_types.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go).
   - Added `ConsistentHash` to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L194-L197) in [traffic_policy_types.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go) and regenerated deepcopy functions and Helm CRDs ([gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml)).

2. **Translation & Merge Logic**:
   - Implemented [`consistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L19-L27), [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L143-L305), [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L307-L320), and [`mergeConsistentHashIRs`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L384-L405) in [consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go).
   - Wired construction, validation, route application, and policy merging in [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), and [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L625-L678) in [merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ewogi1yt/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go).

3. **Tests**:
